newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Bondes rate falls slightly at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Bondes rate falls slightly at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican government 728-day development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.03 percentage points to 1.42 percent above the one-month Cetes rate in Monday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 728-day bondes were assigned at a price of 97.72204 pesos.
Demand for the Bondes was 3.625 billion pesos, compared with the 900 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
